name: Premex AB — Phone MCP: AI Assistant Server
connects_via: On-phone SSE server (Ktor, port 3001); LAN direct (bearer) or phonemcp.ai tunnel (OAuth 2.1, single-use pairing codes)
governance: Best-in-class toolbox mitigations per report: tools off until enabled, sensitive tools need explicit consent, revocable paired-client list, Keystore-backed token storage. UI-automation module exists only as a design spec in-repo — NOT shipped.
pricing: App free; local Wi-Fi 'will always be free'; remote = 30-day trial then unstated subscription

name: PhoneMCP (phone-mcp.com)
connects_via: Claude/ChatGPT -> PhoneMCP MCP server -> Android phone sends texts on user's plan
governance: Red flag per report §5: no visible pricing, maker, privacy policy or repo on homepage.

name: AGI Inc — AGI Agentic Phone MCP
connects_via: On-device Accessibility app <-> AGI cloud MCP server; client calls phone_run_task (NL prompt) -> task_id, polls phone_task_monitor
governance: Execution visible on screen; logins/payments/confirmations/CAPTCHAs handed back to user (vendor claim). No primitive tap tools exposed — the vendor's agent loop runs them.
pricing: Free beta credits; no list price found

name: hao-cyber — Phone MCP Plugin
connects_via: Host-side ADB; USB debugging required — project states tools do not function without the host connection
governance: No background/on-device story; dies with the cable/host.

name: viandwi24/phone-mcp
connects_via: On-device APK (foreground service + Accessibility + MediaProjection) -> outbound WebSocket -> self-hosted Bun broker; MCP server is stdio, local to the agent host. No ADB, no root.
governance: Report flags: ONE shared PHONE_MCP_TOKEN guards phone + agent sides, travels in WS URL/header (README warns to use wss://); no per-device credentials or selective revocation; debug-signed release APKs; anti-detection pacing discussed in its architecture doc (ToS signal). Wake/lock semantics honest: swipe/none locks only, credential locks hard-fail to human.

name: htekdev/phone-mcp-server
connects_via: On-phone Termux Streamable-HTTP server (http://<phone-ip>:3000/mcp), LAN

capabilities.calls_sms: 18 tools: sms, calls, contacts, flashlight, camera, GPS, clipboard

governance: RED FLAG (report §5): NO authentication by default on a server that can send SMS and place calls; own README warns 'only run on trusted networks'.

name: ScreenMCP (ex-PhoneMCP)
type_licence: OSS app MIT; hosted relay paid
connects_via: On-device Accessibility app -> WebSocket relay (hosted or self-hosted)
governance: No ADB by design; works across networks. iOS not available (Apple restrictions).
pricing: Hosted quotas: 100 cmds/day free, 2,000 @ $9/mo, 20,000 @ $29/mo (comparison page, verified live)

name: mobile-mcp (mobile-next)
connects_via: Host-side: ADB (Android), Xcode/mobilecli (iOS); optional Mobile Next Cloud
governance: Simulators/emulators/real devices; recording, clipboard, GPS override, logs/crashes tools.

name: CursorTouch/Android-MCP
connects_via: Host ADB, USB or Wi-Fi
governance: Android 10+, Python 3.13. Project warns: use in controlled environments with untrusted prompts.

name: minhalvp/android-mcp-server
connects_via: Host ADB
governance: Minimal/educational; raw shell = maximal risk per line of code (report).

name: DroidMind (hyperb1iss)
connects_via: Host ADB, USB/TCP-IP
governance: Debugging-oriented (logcat/ANR/crash/battery, bug reports, heap). Critical commands blocked by default; shell allowlist + audit logging = safeguard worth copying (report §5).

name: scrcpy-mcp (JuanCF)
connects_via: Host ADB + scrcpy
governance: Video/audio streaming tools; scrcpy can turn the physical screen off while mirroring — the app is still foreground.

name: ScreenSync MCP (EpsolDev)
connects_via: LAN hub (Node) + app; control via ADB USB/wireless; mDNS + QR pairing, bearer token
governance: Android 7+; MediaProjection consent EACH session; 29 phone/desktop tools (its '226 tools' headline is mostly a browser extension).

name: PhonePi MCP (priyankark)
connects_via: Desktop server <-> phone app, LOCAL NETWORK ONLY (Tailscale recommended)

capabilities.calls_sms: 23+ direct API-style actions: SMS, calls, contacts, notifications, snippets, clipboard, battery, timers

governance: No cloud relay; no UI control.

name: Melaya Device Control
connects_via: On-device Accessibility app <-> remote MCP api.melaya.org/mcp, OAuth 2.1, QR pairing
governance: STRONGEST governance story found (report §5): per-app allowlist double-enforced (server + on-device against actual foreground package), HITL gates for publish/send/spend/delete/account changes, short-lived single-use pairing codes, device tokens stored server-side as hashes (vendor claims, verified as published).

name: Mika (wangzan101)
connects_via: On-device agent; shell-identity helper started via wireless-debugging pairing; computer access via USB (adb forward) or LAN/VPN MCP/CLI

capabilities.shell: Linux sandbox per conversation (arm64) + shell-identity helper on device
capabilities.calls_sms: via apps; logins/OTP/payments handed to user

governance: The ONLY true concurrent-background design found (hidden VirtualDisplay while user uses main screen; Android 14+ recommended for independent focus). Computer-submitted tasks CANNOT approve gated actions — approval on the phone. LAN mode off by default.

name: Mobilerun (ex-DroidRun)
connects_via: Local: Portal APK (Accessibility) via framework; Cloud: hosted MCP, your phone via Portal or their cloud phones

capabilities.calls_sms: via apps; notification events in Portal

governance: Report §6 lesson: the monetisable layer turned out to be hosting, identity and fleet, not the control primitives.
pricing: Cloud (index, vendor skills doc): personal phone $5/mo, cloud phone $50/mo, hosted MCP free tier 60 device-min + 500 credits/mo, dedicated iPhone $160/mo billed yearly

name: Karagoz MCP
connects_via: Host-side, 4 targets: Android emulator/device, iOS simulator/device
governance: iOS device path: macOS, Xcode, paired iPhone, Developer Mode, USB + UI Automation + installed runner.

name: BrowserStack MCP / Sauce Labs MCP
connects_via: Cloud real devices, account/API key

capabilities.tap_swipe_type: no free-form step control — sessions/test runs

governance: Built for test execution, not for living on a signed-in personal phone.

name: Corellium-MCP
type_licence: Commercial virtual devices + OSS MCP glue
connects_via: Cloud virtual iOS/Android (hypervisor)
governance: Pen-test/forensics niche; virtual, rooted/jailbroken-class devices — not a personal-phone pattern.
